system.description:
Built on Project FU's variant, GUISES-core-rules.md section 8.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Arcanist counterpart.)

ARCANIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000015]{Bind and Summon} 【Max SL 1】

Bind Arcana to your soul as the story grants them. Action + 30 MP summons a bound Arcanum and merges you with it — merge benefits, a pulse, and a dismiss effect. Taken at creation, you begin play with one Arcanum bound.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000016]{Arcane Regeneration} 【Max SL 6】

After you willingly dismiss a merged Arcanum, if you are in Crisis: you and every ally present recover (SL × 5) HP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000017]{Phantom Strength} 【Max SL 5】

While merged: +(SL) damage on free attacks, pulses and spells. With an arcane, dagger or flail weapon equipped, your pulse and dismiss damage may ignore Affinities.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000018]{Quick Summoning} 【Max SL 4】

When summoning on your turn, choose up to two: reduce the MP cost by (SL × 5); and/or perform the pulse immediately. One option locks the Arcanum in until your next turn; both forfeit its dismiss effect for this summoning.
